title: Studio gate reply
description: video/<slug>/studio/replies/<gateId>.json. Written once by the studio (or a test) to answer the gate of the same gateId.

decision.description: "approve" approves the stage; the other decisions per stage are defined by the web studio.

notes.description: The user's comments; may be empty.

changes.description: The fields the user edited in the studio, so Claude knows what to re-read.

choice.description: What the user chose, for the decisions that choose: pick {id}, mix {id, mix}, another-round {priorities}, regenerate {regenerate}. The other decisions carry none.

id.description: The treatment picked, or the base of a mix.

mix.description: Elements taken from the treatments, as in treatments.json chosen.mix.

priorities.description: What the next Gauntlet round looks at first.

regenerate.description: The generated assets to make again, as paths relative to the project.
